certification.name: AWS Cloud Red Team Specialist
certification.description: Red team certification for AWS covering attack surface enumeration, exploitation of misconfigured services and pivoting across VPCs. Earned by submitting at least 10 flags in a 30-day practical challenge lab.
certification.currency_note: Includes course material and a 30-day challenge lab; lower promotional prices are frequent; a separate CARTS V2 edition is listed at $149
